simple.summary: גְּזַר (gᵉzar) means to quarry ; determine First listed occurrence: Dan 2 27.

definitions.full: H1505. gezar [ גְּזַר ] verb cut, (divide,) determine (so ᵑ7 Syriac, in both meanings; Biblical Hebrew usually divide , Job, Esther, decree ); — Pe . Participle active as substantive, plural absolute גָָּֽזְרִין determiners (of fate; astrologers or soothsayers) Dan 2:27 ; 5:11 ; emphatic גָָּֽזְרַיָּא 4:4 ; 5:7 (compare Dr.; Arabic RS JPhil. xiii (1885), 781 ). Hithpe`el Perfect 3feminine singular הִתְגְּזֶרֶת Dan 2:34 a stone was cut out , so ׳אִתְג (K § § 23, 1; 30, 2 ) 2:45 (with מִן of source).
